findings.note: Contract tests for the KEP's byte-for-byte compatibility guarantee. On main (and on this docs-only PR head) they pass: the legacy containers merge appends env once per reference with NO duplicate-name check. If the KEP implementation makes the 'shared env-name conflict check spanning all three passes' (README Compatibility item 3) reject this output, these tests go red — proof of the compatibility break. See results/harness-bites-check.txt for the demonstrated flip.

Contract tests pinning the main behaviors the KEP claims are 'preserved verbatim': init-container legacy override is a silent no-op; an override naming another reference's container is skipped; append-if-missing pod-level delivery. They pin the accuracy of the KEP's factual claims about main; deviations after implementation are regressions of the documented compatibility surface.
